train_model: train a transformers model on a dataset using the Trainer class with custom training arguments
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained transformers model on an evaluation dataset and return computed metrics
predict_data: run predictions on a test dataset using the Trainer predict method and return predictions with metrics
save_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint including optimizer, scheduler, and RNG states to a specified output directory
hyperparameter_search: launch a hyperparameter search using optuna or ray tune backend to find optimal training parameters
